## Problem
3 directives call external APIs directly on every scoring run instead of querying stored database tables:
- Wastes rate limits
- Fails when provider is down
- Data not stored for backtesting

## Status: 2/5 already DB-backed
- earnings-momentum: Already uses prisma.earningsEvent.findMany() — zero API calls
- news-sentiment-positive: Already mock/neutral — zero API calls

## Remaining: 2 directives (social-buzz deferred to phase-2)

| Directive | Calls | DB Table Needed |
|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| insider-activity | Finnhub /insider-transactions | InsiderTransaction |
| dilution-impact | Finnhub /stock/metric | ShareCount |

social-buzz deferred: social media sentiment is noisy/low-signal. Tracked separately in the social-networks epic.

## Acceptance
- [ ] 2 directives read from database tables (zero external API calls)
- [ ] InsiderTransaction + ShareCount tables in Prisma schema
- [ ] Import jobs run periodically
- [ ] Directives return neutral with confidence=0 when DB data is missing
